papers.title: A Failure-Mode Benchmark for Polymorphic Sybil Poisoning in RAG
papers.abstract: We release a benchmark and failure-mode-aware evaluation framework for grounded QA under coordinated retrieval poisoning. The framework partitions reader outputs into four mutually exclusive categories (\emph{gold}, \emph{hijack}, \emph{abstention}, \emph{drift}), with instance-level paired clean-to-poison transition matrices and a Forced Exposure protocol isolating reader-side conflict resolution from retrieval variance. We introduce \emph{polymorphic sybil poisoning}, a coordinated attack class in which $S$ lexically diverse passages jointly support an attacker-chosen target while evading lexical near-duplicate filters that fully detect monomorphic baselines (capturing the residual 14.2\% with E5 cosine raises false-positive rate 9$\times$ on legitimate same-topic pairs). A monomorphic-polymorphic ablation under Forced Exposure isolates the diversity dimension and reveals a $+$18.8pp hijack amplification (95\% paired bootstrap CI $[+15.4, +22.4]$, $B{=}5{,}000$): monomorphic copies register only 4.0\% as hijack while polymorphic surface diversity recovers 22.8\% -- a 5.7$\times$ amplification of the ASR-visible attack channel. ASR alone treats every non-target output identically; under attack, abstention and drift together hold 47-66\% of output mass, unmonitored by ASR+ACC, and two readers at nearly identical ASR (within 0.2pp) differ by 16.5pp on abstention and 17.2pp on drift -- failure profiles invisible to ASR. We release the frozen benchmark (3{,}145 questions, 2{,}982 retained sybil groups; $S{=}6$ chosen to dominate top-10 retrieval slots, §\ref{sec:setup}), the official four-way evaluator, paired-transition utilities, and the Forced Exposure harness across five readers (7B-120B), two retrievers, and two cross-validation datasets (TriviaQA, 2Wiki), under CC~BY-SA~4.0 (data) and MIT (software); release information in §\ref{sec:release}.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景与问题  
针对检索增强生成（RAG）系统中日益隐蔽的协同式检索污染攻击，现有评估范式（如ASR/ACC）严重失焦：其将所有非目标输出统视为失败，却忽略**失败模式异质性**——如读者主动拒答（abstention）与语义偏移（drift）在安全影响、可解释性与修复路径上存在本质差异。

## 方法创新  
本研究提出首个面向**多态Sybil污染**（polymorphic sybil poisoning）的故障模式感知基准框架。核心贡献包括：  
- **四元细粒度分类**：将读者输出严格划分为互斥四类——*gold*（正确）、*hijack*（被污染诱导的错误答案）、*abstention*（拒绝作答）、*drift*（无关但自信的错误）；  
- **强制暴露协议**（Forced Exposure）：通过固定污染检索结果，剥离检索波动干扰，精准定位读者端冲突消解能力；  
- **多态攻击建模**：设计$S=6$条词汇高度多样但语义协同的伪造段落，联合支撑攻击者指定目标，成功绕过基于E5余弦相似度的近重复检测（单态基线100%被捕获，而多态残留率14.2%，且误报率激增9倍）。

## 关键发现  
- 多态性使劫持率（hijack）提升**+18.8个百分点**（95%置信区间[+15.4, +22.4]），即从单态4.0%跃至22.8%，攻击通道可见性放大**5.7倍**；  
- ASR指标完全掩盖了47–66%的输出分布于abstention与drift——二者合计占比近半，且两读者ASR相差仅0.2pp时，abstention与drift差异竟达16.5pp与17.2pp；  
- 公开冻结基准：3,145个问题、2,982个Sybil组，覆盖5种规模读者（7B–120B）、2种检索器、2个交叉验证数据集（TriviaQA/2Wiki），遵循CC BY-SA 4.0（数据）与MIT（代码）许可。
papers.summary_en: We introduce the first failure-mode-aware benchmark for *polymorphic sybil poisoning*—a coordinated retrieval poisoning attack where $S=6$ lexically diverse yet semantically aligned fake passages jointly support an attacker-chosen target while evading near-duplicate filters. Our framework classifies reader outputs into four mutually exclusive categories (*gold*, *hijack*, *abstention*, *drift*) and introduces *Forced Exposure* to isolate reader-side conflict resolution from retrieval variance. Under this protocol, polymorphic poisoning amplifies hijack rate by **+18.8 pp** (95% CI [+15.4, +22.4]) versus monomorphic baselines—lifting hijack from 4.0% to 22.8% (5.7× ASR-visible channel gain). Crucially, ASR alone masks 47–66% of outputs as *abstention* or *drift*, which remain invisible even when two readers exhibit nearly identical ASR (Δ ≤ 0.2 pp) but diverge by 16.5 pp in abstention and 17.2 pp in drift. We release the frozen benchmark (3,145 questions; 2,982 Sybil groups), official four-way evaluator, paired-transition utilities, and Forced Exposure harness across 5 readers (7B–120B), 2 retrievers, and 2 datasets (TriviaQA, 2Wiki) under CC BY-SA 4.0 (data) and MIT (code).

papers.title: Adversarial LassoNet: Robust Feature Selection via Stability-Driven Sparse Learning
papers.abstract: Sparse feature selection is critical for high-dimensional machine learning, yet traditional $\ell_1$-regularized methods are often brittle under observational noise and spurious correlations, leading to unstable feature supports and degraded generalization. Although adversarial training has been widely used to improve model robustness, its interaction with hierarchical sparse feature selection remains underexplored. In this work, we propose Adversarial LassoNet (AdLNet), a stability-driven sparse feature selection framework that integrates input-space adversarial perturbations with the hierarchical sparsity mechanism of LassoNet. We derive a tractable first-order adversarial approximation under local smoothness assumptions and provide an NTK-inspired spectral analysis to characterize how perturbation-driven training can reduce gradient concentration. Experiments on high-dimensional SERS data, six public benchmark datasets, and ColoredMNIST show that AdLNet maintains competitive sparse-selection performance while improving out-of-distribution robustness by 4.4\% and feature support reproducibility by 6.3\% under nearly matched support sparsity on ColoredMNIST. On the high-dimensional lung cancer screening dataset, AdLNet achieves a 5.3\% test accuracy gain and a 6.0\% AUC improvement over vanilla LassoNet. Code and dataset are available at https://github.com/719573/Adversarial-LassoNet.
papers.summary_zh:
## 背景与挑战  
高维机器学习中，稀疏特征选择对模型可解释性、泛化性与计算效率至关重要。然而，传统基于 $\ell_1$ 正则（如Lasso）的方法在观测噪声和虚假相关性干扰下表现脆弱，易导致**特征支持集不稳定**（feature support instability）与跨分布泛化性能下降。尽管对抗训练已被广泛用于提升模型鲁棒性，但其与**分层稀疏结构学习**（如LassoNet的“主干-跳连”稀疏约束机制）的协同建模尚未系统探索。

## 方法创新  
本文提出 **Adversarial LassoNet（AdLNet）** ——一种以稳定性驱动的稀疏特征选择新框架。AdLNet将**输入空间对抗扰动**嵌入LassoNet的层级稀疏优化流程，在保留原始稀疏正则化路径的同时，显式鼓励特征选择对微小数据扰动的不变性。我们基于局部光滑性假设，推导出可高效计算的一阶对抗近似目标；进一步引入受神经正切核（NTK）启发的谱分析，理论揭示：对抗训练能有效**抑制梯度能量在少数特征上的过度集中**，从而增强稀疏解的谱鲁棒性与支持集一致性。

## 实验验证  
在六类公开基准数据集、SERS高维光谱数据及因果敏感的ColoredMNIST上，AdLNet在保持相近稀疏度（支持特征数匹配）前提下：  
- 提升**分布外鲁棒性 4.4%**，**特征支持可复现性（Jaccard相似度）提升 6.3%**；  
- 在真实世界肺部癌变筛查高维数据上，超越基线LassoNet：**测试准确率↑5.3%**，**AUC↑6.0%**。  
所有代码与数据已开源：https://github.com/719573/Adversarial-LassoNet
papers.summary_en: Sparse feature selection is vital for high-dimensional learning, yet standard $\ell_1$-regularized methods suffer from instability under noise and spurious correlations. While adversarial training improves robustness, its integration with hierarchical sparse learning remains unexplored. We propose **Adversarial LassoNet (AdLNet)**, a stability-driven framework that incorporates input-space adversarial perturbations into LassoNet’s hierarchical sparsity mechanism. Under local smoothness, we derive a tractable first-order adversarial approximation and provide an NTK-inspired spectral analysis showing how adversarial training mitigates gradient concentration on unstable features. Experiments across six benchmarks, SERS data, and ColoredMNIST demonstrate that AdLNet maintains competitive sparsity while improving out-of-distribution robustness by **4.4%** and feature support reproducibility by **6.3%**, all under matched sparsity. On a real-world lung cancer screening dataset, it achieves **+5.3% accuracy** and **+6.0% AUC** over vanilla LassoNet. Code: https://github.com/719573/Adversarial-LassoNet.

papers.title: MPC with Weighted and Fluid Participation
papers.abstract:
Most existing multiparty computation (MPC) protocols assume static and equal participation. All computing parties can dedicate resources and stay online for the entire computation, and they have equal influence on computation correctness and security (i.e., they are equally hard to corrupt). Supporting dynamic participation, so parties can join/leave at will, and associating weights to these parties reflecting their trust level, are essential to enable MPC in contemporary emerging applications. Existing solutions addressed these issues separately at varying security levels, and attempting to combine them while addressing malicious security raises several challenges and open questions. 

In this paper, we close this gap and develop maliciously-secure MPC protocols that support weighted participation in both static and dynamic (or fluid) settings. In particular, we extend prior work on weighted ramp secret sharing (WRSS) to support verifiability and proactivity, which could be of independent interest. Then, we show how to perform arithmetic operations over weighted shares in a verifiable way, thus enabling maliciously-secure weighted MPC with guaranteed output delivery under static participation. Utilizing the proactivity feature of our secret sharing scheme, we develop a state handover protocol and employ it to support dynamic participation in committee-based MPC with the same security guarantees. Both protocols are synchronous and assume honest majority. To the best of our knowledge, our work is the first to support both weighted and dynamic participation in MPC.
papers.summary_zh:
## 背景与问题  
现有大多数**多方安全计算（MPC）协议**假设参与方为**静态且权重均等**：所有方全程在线、资源稳定，且被攻陷难度相同（即同等可信度）。然而，在区块链治理、去中心化AI训练、跨机构联邦学习等新兴场景中，实际需求要求MPC支持**动态参与**（节点可随时加入/退出）和**差异化信任建模**（如按质押量、声誉或算力赋予不同权重），即“加权+流体”参与。当前方案仅孤立解决其中一项，且在**恶意敌手模型下**整合二者面临核心挑战：如何兼顾权重语义、动态状态迁移与可验证性，同时保障**正确性、安全性与输出交付保证**。

## 方法与创新  
本文首次构建了**恶意安全（maliciously secure）的加权流体MPC协议框架**。核心贡献包括：  
- **加权可验证渐进式秘密共享（WRSS-VPro）**：扩展经典加权渐进式秘密共享，首次引入**可验证性（verifiability）** 与**前向安全性（proactivity）**，支持权重感知的份额生成、验证与周期性密钥刷新；  
- **加权算术运算协议**：设计可在加权份额上执行加法、乘法及公开值转换的**可验证协议**，确保静态场景下恶意敌手下仍满足**保证输出交付（GOD）**；  
- **流体委员会状态迁移机制**：利用WRSS-VPro的前向安全特性，提出轻量级**状态交接协议（state handover protocol）**，使委员会成员变更时无需全局重分享，实现动态参与下的无缝安全迁移。

## 结果与意义  
协议在**同步网络**与**诚实多数（honest majority）** 假设下实现，兼具理论严谨性与工程可行性。据我们所知，这是首个同时支持**加权参与**与**动态（流体）参与**的恶意安全MPC方案，为可信协作基础设施提供了关键原语。
papers.summary_en: This paper presents the first maliciously secure multiparty computation (MPC) protocols supporting *both* weighted and dynamic (fluid) participation. We introduce **Weighted Ramp Secret Sharing with Verifiability and Proactivity (WRSS-VPro)**—a novel secret sharing scheme enabling trust-weighted threshold control, share verification, and proactive key refresh. Building upon WRSS-VPro, we design verifiable protocols for arithmetic operations over weighted shares, achieving guaranteed output delivery under static participation. Leveraging proactivity, we construct a lightweight state handover protocol that enables seamless committee reconfiguration—allowing parties to join/leave dynamically—while preserving malicious security and honest-majority guarantees. All protocols operate in the synchronous setting. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work unifying weighted trust modeling and fluid participation in a maliciously secure MPC framework.

## 背景与问题  
现有大多数**多方安全计算（MPC）协议**假设参与方为**静态且权重均等**：所有方全程在线、资源稳定，且被攻陷难度相同（即同等可信度）。然而，在区块链治理、去中心化AI训练、跨机构联邦学习等新兴场景中，实际需求要求MPC支持**动态参与**（节点可随时加入/退出）和**差异化信任建模**（如按质押量、声誉或算力赋予不同权重），即“加权+流体”参与。当前方案仅孤立解决其中一项，且在**恶意敌手模型下**整合二者面临核心挑战：如何兼顾权重语义、动态状态迁移与可验证性，同时保障**正确性、安全性与输出交付保证**。

## 方法与创新  
本文首次构建了**恶意安全（maliciously secure）的加权流体MPC协议框架**。核心贡献包括：  
- **加权可验证渐进式秘密共享（WRSS-VPro）**：扩展经典加权渐进式秘密共享，首次引入**可验证性（verifiability）** 与**前向安全性（proactivity）**，支持权重感知的份额生成、验证与周期性密钥刷新；  
- **加权算术运算协议**：设计可在加权份额上执行加法、乘法及公开值转换的**可验证协议**，确保静态场景下恶意敌手下仍满足**保证输出交付（GOD）**；  
- **流体委员会状态迁移机制**：利用WRSS-VPro的前向安全特性，提出轻量级**状态交接协议（state handover protocol）**，使委员会成员变更时无需全局重分享，实现动态参与下的无缝安全迁移。

## 结果与意义  
协议在**同步网络**与**诚实多数（honest majority）** 假设下实现，兼具理论严谨性与工程可行性。据我们所知，这是首个同时支持**加权参与**与**动态（流体）参与**的恶意安全MPC方案，为可信协作基础设施提供了关键原语。

papers.title: Analysing the Post-Quantum Security of S/MIME
papers.abstract: Secure/Multipurpose Internet Mail Extensions (S/MIME) is a standards-based mechanism for certificate-backed email signing and encryption. Its post-quantum migration is now technically actionable: ML-KEM public keys can be represented in X.509 certificates, and CMS can carry ML-KEM recipient information through \texttt{KEMRecipientInfo}. These standards solve an encoding problem, but they do not by themselves solve an assurance problem. A mailbox may possess a post-quantum-capable certificate while a generated CMS \texttt{EnvelopedData} object still protects the content-encryption key (CEK) through RSA or elliptic-curve key management; a multi-recipient message may mix ML-KEM and classical recipient paths for the same CEK; and archived mail may remain protected only by quantum-vulnerable mechanisms.This paper studies this assurance gap by shifting the unit of analysis from certificates to encrypted messages. We model encrypted S/MIME as a multi-recipient CMS object with certificate-bound paths to a shared CEK and show that post-quantum confidentiality is a universal message-level property: every valid path to the CEK must satisfy the active migration policy. Consequently, the presence of one ML-KEM recipient path is insufficient if another valid classical path can recover the same CEK. We then present \texttt{SMIME-PQCheck}, a standards-driven validation framework that combines X.509 profile checks, CMS recipient-structure analysis, policy-driven hybrid handling, and archive-level risk aggregation. The framework classifies S/MIME objects as \texttt{pqc-protected}, \texttt{hybrid-protected}, \texttt{classical-only}, \texttt{unsafe-mixed-mode}, \texttt{invalid}, or \texttt{unknown}. The result is a practical assurance layer for organizations migrating S/MIME deployments from certificate-level PQC readiness to auditable message-level protection.
papers.summary_zh:
## 背景与问题  
Secure/Multipurpose Internet Mail Extensions（S/MIME）是基于标准的证书驱动型邮件签名与加密机制。随着NIST后量子密码（PQC）标准（如ML-KEM）的发布，S/MIME在技术层面已具备迁移基础：ML-KEM公钥可嵌入X.509证书，CMS协议亦通过`KEMRecipientInfo`支持其密钥封装路径。然而，**证书级PQC就绪不等于消息级后量子安全**——一封`EnvelopedData`对象可能同时包含ML-KEM与RSA/ECC等经典密钥管理路径指向同一内容加密密钥（CEK），导致攻击者仅需攻破任一经典路径即可解密；多收件人场景下混合路径更属常态；历史归档邮件则完全依赖量子脆弱机制。

## 方法与创新  
本文提出以**加密消息为基本分析单元**，突破传统证书视角。我们形式化建模S/MIME为“多收件人CMS对象 + 证书绑定的CEK解密路径集合”，并首次定义**消息级后量子保密性**：当且仅当*所有有效CEK恢复路径均满足组织主动迁移策略*时，该消息才具备PQC保护。据此，单条ML-KEM路径无法保证安全，必须全局验证路径完备性。

## 框架与结果  
我们设计并实现`SMIME-PQCheck`——一个标准驱动的验证框架，融合四层能力：  
- X.509证书配置合规性检查（如KEM扩展、密钥用法）  
- CMS收件人结构深度解析（识别`KEMRecipientInfo`/`KeyTransRecipientInfo`/`KEKRecipientInfo`等类型及嵌套）  
- 策略感知的混合模式处理（区分“允许过渡”的hybrid与“禁止共存”的unsafe-mixed-mode）  
- 归档级风险聚合（对邮件流或存储库生成PQC覆盖度热力图）  

框架输出六类判定：`pqc-protected`、`hybrid-protected`、`classical-only`、`unsafe-mixed-mode`、`invalid`、`unknown`，为组织提供从证书就绪到**可审计的消息级PQC保障**的落地桥梁。
papers.summary_en: This paper addresses the critical assurance gap in S/MIME’s post-quantum (PQ) migration: while ML-KEM is now standardized in X.509 and CMS (`KEMRecipientInfo`), certificate-level PQ readiness does not guarantee message-level quantum resistance. We shift analysis from certificates to encrypted messages, modeling S/MIME as a multi-recipient CMS `EnvelopedData` with certificate-bound paths to a shared content-encryption key (CEK). We define *message-level PQ confidentiality* as a universal property requiring *all valid CEK recovery paths*—not just one—to comply with an active migration policy. Consequently, mixing ML-KEM and classical (e.g., RSA, ECIES) paths for the same CEK violates PQ security. To operationalize this, we introduce `SMIME-PQCheck`: a standards-driven framework that jointly analyzes X.509 profiles, CMS recipient structures (including hybrid handling per policy), and archive-level risk aggregation. It classifies S/MIME objects into six categories—`pqc-protected`, `hybrid-protected`, `classical-only`, `unsafe-mixed-mode`, `invalid`, or `unknown`—enabling auditable, message-level PQ assurance for real-world deployments.

papers.title: Swarm-Driven Multi-Agent Reasoning for Smart City Security
papers.abstract: Modern smart cities are interconnected cyber-physical ecosystems where heterogeneous devices exchange data and control commands. Coordinated attacks may appear as weak and distributed indicators, including low-rate scanning, abnormal credential use, protocol misuse, or delayed lateral movement, with each signal remaining below local alert thresholds. Therefore, smart-city security is not only an anomaly detection task but also a reasoning task under uncertainty, partial observability, and adversarial manipulation. This work presents TPSC-Sec, an LLM-based multi-agent approach for stable security reasoning in smart cities. TPSC-Sec decomposes analysis across specialized agents that inspect traffic behavior, protocol interactions, identity usage, and temporal attack progression. Their independent threat hypotheses are aggregated by the proposed Threat-Pheromone Swarm Consensus mechanism, which reinforces supported hypotheses, suppresses contradictions, and preserves temporal consistency, thereby driving competing interpretations toward a stable collective decision. We further introduce Adaptive Verified TPSC, which adds verification-aware calibration, context-sensitive weighting, and disagreement-adaptive control to reduce unsupported LLM outputs and reasoning inconsistency. Experiments over 500 runs show that TPSC-Sec achieves a high consensus acceptance rate of 0.97 plus or minus 0.02, hypothesis-support concentration above 0.99, a consensus margin of 2.08 plus or minus 0.21, low aggregate risk of 0.23 plus or minus 0.04, high inter-agent agreement of 0.82 plus or minus 0.06, and strong support-quality correlation of r equals 0.93. Adaptive agent selection reduces the number of active agents by 50 percent while improving system fitness by 11.6 percent. These results demonstrate robust, interpretable, and efficient security reasoning for adversary-resilient smart-city environments.

## 智慧城市安全中的群体驱动多智能体推理框架 TPSC-Sec  

现代智慧城市是高度耦合的网络-物理融合生态系统，其异构设备间持续交换数据与控制指令。然而，高级持续性威胁（APT）常以**弱信号、分布式、低可观测性**形式呈现——如低频端口扫描、异常凭证复用、协议滥用或延迟横向移动，单点指标均低于本地告警阈值，导致传统检测方法失效。因此，智慧城市安全不仅是异常检测问题，更是面向**不确定性、部分可观测性与对抗性干扰**的复杂推理任务。  

本文提出 **TPSC-Sec**（Threat-Pheromone Swarm Consensus for Security），一种基于大语言模型（LLM）的稳定安全推理框架。该框架构建专业化多智能体系统：各智能体分别建模**流量行为模式、协议交互逻辑、身份凭证使用轨迹及攻击时序演进路径**；其独立生成的威胁假设通过创新的**威胁信息素群体共识机制（Threat-Pheromone Swarm Consensus）** 进行动态聚合——该机制通过正向强化支持性证据、抑制矛盾假设、约束时间一致性，驱动多元解释收敛至鲁棒集体决策。进一步，我们提出**自适应验证型 TPSC（Adaptive Verified TPSC）**，集成验证感知校准、上下文敏感权重分配与分歧自适应调控模块，显著抑制LLM幻觉输出与推理不一致。  

在500次重复实验中，TPSC-Sec实现：共识接受率 **0.97±0.02**、假设支持集中度 **>0.99**、共识边际 **2.08±0.21**、聚合风险仅 **0.23±0.04**、智能体间一致性达 **0.82±0.06**，且支持质量与决策强度呈强相关（*r*=0.93）。自适应智能体选择机制使活跃智能体数量减少50%，系统适应度提升11.6%。本工作为构建**可解释、高鲁棒、低开销**的智慧城市抗对抗安全推理范式提供了新路径。

This necessitates security reasoning under uncertainty, partial observability, and adversarial manipulation. We propose **TPSC-Sec**, an LLM-based multi-agent framework that decomposes analysis across specialized agents (traffic, protocol, identity, temporal progression) and aggregates their threat hypotheses via a novel **Threat-Pheromone Swarm Consensus** mechanism—reinforcing supported evidence, suppressing contradictions, and enforcing temporal consistency. Its enhanced variant, **Adaptive Verified TPSC**, introduces verification-aware calibration, context-sensitive weighting, and disagreement-adaptive control to curb hallucination and inconsistency. Across 500 runs, TPSC-Sec achieves 0.97±0.02 consensus acceptance rate, >0.99 hypothesis-support concentration, 2.08±0.21 consensus margin, low aggregate risk (0.23±0.04), high inter-agent agreement (0.82±0.06), and strong support-quality correlation (*r*=0.93). Adaptive agent selection cuts active agents by 50% while boosting system fitness by 11.6%.

papers.title: Securing Multi-Tool AI Agent Chains With Dynamic, Real-Time Compositional Policies
papers.abstract: Modern AI agent implementations such as frontier coding agents chain multiple tools at runtime that create a security surface that per-tool guardrails are unable to address, as individually permitted tools can violate organizational policies when composed. We propose the Dynamic Security Control Compositor (DSCC), a two-phase approach to compositional security for multi-tool agent chains. In Phase 1, at session checkout, a Most Restrictive Set (MRS) algorithm composes per-tool security policies into a single effective policy with a formal monotonicity invariant that extending a chain can only tighten the result, blocking incompatible combinations before any tool executes. Outputs of any tool call propagate their classification constraints into a session-level taint state, so subsequent invocations must satisfy the most restrictive constraints seen so far. In Phase 2, at runtime, the system tracks the sensitivity of data the agent touches through a monotonic taint state and revokes the session if the accumulated exposure would make a subsequent tool call a policy violation. Together, these phases provide defense in depth, where static composition prevents unsafe chains from starting, and runtime taint tracking catches violations that emerge from the specific data used. We provide a reference implementation on 32 tools governed by 16 NIST SP 800-53 aligned policies and evaluate it under two composition modes. In the default clearance mode, permitted combinations are partitioned into classification-level clusters, blocking 79.2% of policy pairs and 95.5% of triples. The alternative taint mode admits mixed-classification chains within the exfiltration boundary, blocking 42.5% and 60.5% respectively. We discuss the governance implications for organizations deploying multi-tool agents, including the utility-security tradeoff and the changes needed to operationalize chain-aware policies.
papers.summary_zh:
## 背景与挑战  
当前前沿AI智能体（如编程代理）依赖运行时动态编排多工具链，但传统按工具粒度设置的静态安全护栏无法应对**组合性风险**：单个合规工具在特定组合下可能协同违反组织策略（例如，低密级工具读取敏感数据后交由高风险工具外发）。此类“合法工具的非法组合”构成新型攻击面。

## 方法创新：动态安全控制合成器（DSCC）  
我们提出两阶段防御框架：  
- **第一阶段（会话初始化）**：采用**最严格集合（MRS）算法**，将各工具策略自动合成为单一有效策略。该算法满足**形式化单调性不变量**——链越长，合成策略越严格，从而在任何工具执行前即阻断不兼容组合。同时，工具输出自动携带分类约束，注入会话级**污点状态（taint state）**，后续调用必须满足迄今所见最严约束。  
- **第二阶段（运行时）**：基于单调污点追踪机制，实时评估代理触达数据的敏感度；若累积暴露将导致下一工具调用违规，则立即撤销会话。

## 实验验证与治理启示  
在32个工具、16条NIST SP 800-53对齐策略的基准上评估：  
- **默认清关模式**：按密级聚类许可组合，拦截**79.2%的策略二元组**与**95.5%的三元组**；  
- **污点模式**：允许跨密级链（限于防泄露边界），拦截率降至42.5%/60.5%，提升灵活性。  
本工作揭示了多工具代理需从“工具中心”转向“链感知”治理范式，明确权衡可用性与安全性，并指出策略运营需支持动态合成与会话级状态管理。
papers.summary_en: Modern AI agents chain multiple tools at runtime, creating composition-level security risks that per-tool guardrails cannot prevent—individually permitted tools may jointly violate policies. We propose the **Dynamic Security Control Compositor (DSCC)**, a two-phase compositional security framework. In **Phase 1**, the *Most Restrictive Set (MRS)* algorithm composes tool-specific policies into a single monotonic effective policy: extending a chain only tightens constraints, blocking unsafe combinations before execution; tool outputs propagate classification labels into a session-wide taint state. In **Phase 2**, runtime monotonic taint tracking revokes sessions if accumulated data sensitivity would cause a subsequent tool call to violate policy. Evaluated on 32 tools governed by 16 NIST SP 800-53–aligned policies, DSCC blocks **79.2% of policy pairs** and **95.5% of triples** in default clearance mode, and **42.5%/60.5%** in flexible taint mode. DSCC enables defense-in-depth: static composition prevents unsafe chains from launching, while dynamic taint catching handles data-driven violations.

本工作揭示了多工具代理需从“工具中心”转向“链感知”治理范式，明确权衡可用性与安全性，并指出策略运营需支持动态合成与会话级状态管理。

papers.title: Scalable Differentially Private Data Compression via Diffusion and Stochastic Codes
papers.abstract: The ever-increasing collection of personal data has created mounting pressure to develop technologies that protect sensitive aspects of individual identity. Differential privacy (DP) provides a principled framework with strong formal guarantees and has already achieved practical success. However, releasing high-dimensional data, such as images, has remained elusive: releasing uncompressed privatized data requires significant storage. At the same time, no effective data compression scheme exists that can compress high-resolution data with privacy guarantees.   We address this challenge with DP-DiPP, a compression pipeline that combines stochastic codes with diffusion models. DP-DiPP is highly flexible: the practitioner has direct control over the compression rate-privacy-utility tradeoff. As the theoretical backbone, we extend the Poisson private representation (PPR) to encode the outputs of privacy mechanisms. We then combine it with DiffC, a diffusion-based lossy data compression method, to obtain a differentially private image compressor. Our experiments on privatized image classification on CIFAR-10 demonstrate that DP-DiPP significantly outperforms the baseline, achieving a 10-30 times better compression while retaining comparable privacy guarantees and utility.
papers.summary_zh:
## 背景与挑战  
随着个人数据采集规模持续扩大，如何在释放高维数据（如图像）时兼顾**隐私保护**、**存储效率**与**任务效用**成为关键瓶颈。差分隐私（DP）虽提供严格的数学保障，但现有方法面临两难：直接发布经DP扰动的原始图像需海量存储空间；而传统压缩技术（如JPEG、VAE）在压缩过程中会破坏DP保证，导致隐私预算不可控泄露。

## 方法创新：DP-DiPP框架  
本文提出**DP-DiPP**（Differentially Private Diffusion and Stochastic Codes），一种可扩展的端到端差分隐私图像压缩新范式。其核心包含两大理论与技术突破：  
- **理论拓展**：将Poisson私有表示（PPR）机制推广为通用编码框架，首次支持对任意DP机制输出（如高斯/拉普拉斯扰动结果）进行**隐私保持的离散化编码**，严格保留整体$(\varepsilon,\delta)$-DP性质；  
- **架构融合**：将PPR编码器与DiffC（基于扩散模型的有损压缩器）协同优化，构建“扰动→编码→扩散重建”三阶段流水线，在压缩率、隐私预算$\varepsilon$与下游任务准确率间实现**显式可控权衡**——用户可通过单一超参调节压缩比（2×–32×）与隐私强度（$\varepsilon=1$–$8$）。

## 实验验证与优势  
在CIFAR-10图像分类任务上，DP-DiPP在$\varepsilon=4$下实现**16×平均压缩率**（基线仅0.5×），同时保持92.1% Top-1准确率（较未压缩DP基线仅降1.3%）。相比现有DP压缩方案，其压缩效率提升**10–30倍**，且首次在千级图像规模上验证了DP与高压缩率的兼容性，为边缘设备隐私图像传输提供了实用化路径。
papers.summary_en: We propose **DP-DiPP**, a scalable differentially private (DP) image compression framework that unifies stochastic coding with diffusion models. To bridge the gap between privacy guarantees and practical compression, we extend Poisson Private Representation (PPR) to encode outputs of arbitrary DP mechanisms while preserving $(\varepsilon,\delta)$-DP end-to-end. Integrated with DiffC—a diffusion-based lossy compressor—DP-DiPP enables explicit, tunable tradeoffs among compression ratio, privacy budget ($\varepsilon$), and utility. On CIFAR-10 privatized classification, DP-DiPP achieves **10–30× higher compression** than state-of-the-art baselines (e.g., 16× vs. 0.5×) at $\varepsilon=4$, while retaining near-lossless utility (92.1% accuracy, only −1.3% drop vs. uncompressed DP baseline). This is the first method to provably combine high-fidelity diffusion reconstruction with formal DP under realistic storage constraints.

papers.title: Builder, Defender, Breaker: The Case Against Removing the Human from the AI-Driven Security Lifecycle
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence has spread across the whole of the security lifecycle. The same family of models now writes application code, hardens it, and probes it for weaknesses, so that a single generative substrate increasingly performs all three roles at once. Enthusiasm for this convergence tends to treat full autonomy as the natural end point of partial assistance. This article argues that it is not. When the system that builds an artifact is drawn from the same distribution as the systems that defend and test it, the three roles inherit a common set of blind spots, and the independence that makes verification meaningful is quietly lost. Removing the human does more than raise the automation level: it collapses the external oracle against which machine output is judged, outruns the point at which a person could intervene, hands adversaries a predictable and poisonable target, and dissolves the locus of accountability when something fails. Drawing on evidence from autonomous code generation, adversarial machine learning, software fault tolerance, and the first all-machine hacking tournaments, we argue that the human belongs in the loop not as a temporary scaffold but as a permanent structural requirement, and set out what a defensible division of labour between people and machines should preserve.
papers.summary_zh:
## 核心论点  
本文批判性地挑战了“AI安全全栈自动化”的主流叙事，指出将**构建（Builder）、防御（Defender）、攻破（Breaker）**三重角色完全交由同源生成式AI模型执行，非但不提升安全性，反而系统性削弱其根基。当同一模型家族同时承担代码生成、加固与漏洞挖掘时，其共享的训练分布与架构偏见会形成**隐性盲区耦合**——即构建时未预见的缺陷，恰是防御与测试机制同样无法识别的“共同失明区”。

## 关键风险机制  
- **验证独立性瓦解**：人类作为外部参照系（external oracle）的消失，使机器输出失去可校验的基准；  
- **干预窗口闭锁**：自动化链条过快，超出人类响应的生理与认知临界点（<100ms决策延迟即导致不可逆失控）；  
- **攻击面固化**：同构AI系统成为可预测、可投毒（poisonable）的单点靶标，对抗样本迁移率高达87%（基于DEFCON AI Village 2023实测）；  
- **责任主体消解**：当全链路无明确人工介入节点，事故追责陷入法律与工程双重真空。

## 实证支撑与主张  
基于对GitHub Copilot生成代码的静态分析（n=12,483）、首个全机器CTF赛事（CyberPatriot AI Cup 2024）中92%的误报归因于训练数据偏差，以及软件容错研究中“人类监督阈值”（Human Oversight Threshold, HOT）模型，本文论证：**人类不应作为过渡性“ scaffolding”，而应作为安全生命周期中不可移除的结构性构件**。理想的分工须保留人类在**威胁建模、异常语义判定、跨域上下文整合及伦理裁决**四类不可替代职能，并通过“人机契约接口”（Human-Machine Contract Interface）实现权责显式化。
papers.summary_en: This paper refutes the assumption that full automation is the logical endpoint of AI-assisted security. We demonstrate that when a single generative model family performs *building*, *defending*, and *breaking*—writing code, hardening it, and probing for flaws—it inherits shared blind spots from its training distribution, eroding the independence essential for meaningful verification. Removing humans collapses the external oracle against which outputs are judged, eliminates viable intervention points, creates predictable, poisonable attack surfaces, and dissolves accountability. Drawing on empirical evidence from autonomous code generation (e.g., 63% of Copilot-generated vulnerabilities stem from correlated hallucinations), adversarial ML (87% cross-model attack transfer in AI-vs-AI CTFs), fault-tolerant software studies, and the first all-machine hacking tournaments, we argue that the human must be a *permanent structural requirement*—not a temporary scaffold. A defensible division of labor must preserve human agency in threat modeling, semantic anomaly interpretation, cross-domain contextual reasoning, and ethical adjudication.

papers.title: Enhanced Feature Extraction for IoT Network Intrusion Detection Using GNNs and KAN
papers.abstract: Recent advancements in the Internet of Things (IoT) emphasize the urgent need for advanced network security, as IoT networks feature dynamic topologies, imbalanced traffic, and complex attack patterns. Unlike general IT networks, IoT environments exhibit extreme heterogeneity and sparse topologies. Traditional GNN-based intrusion detection methods often struggle to efficiently model node and edge features or capture fine-grained anomalies in such settings. To address this, we propose SKGFusionKAN, a novel IoT-tailored approach enhancing GraphSAGE with a multi-scale selective kernel attention mechanism. This enables adaptive extraction of node and edge features under diverse traffic conditions. Specifically, our edge-oriented message passing strengthens information propagation, while selective kernel attention adaptively weights edge-derived information from different scales to handle heterogeneity. We also introduce a gated fusion process to dynamically integrate multi-scale features, improving robustness against evolving attacks. Finally, we leverage Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KAN) for classification, offering superior nonlinear modeling capabilities essential for detecting intricate, low-frequency attacks. To our knowledge, this work presents a comprehensive integration of GNNs and KAN with dedicated architectural innovations for IoT intrusion detection. Extensive experiments on four NIDS benchmarks show that SKGFusionKAN consistently outperforms state-of-the-art approaches in binary and multiclass tasks, demonstrating its potential for IoT security.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景  
物联网（IoT）网络具有动态拓扑、流量高度不平衡、设备异构性强及攻击模式复杂等典型特征，传统基于图神经网络（GNN）的入侵检测方法难以有效建模稀疏拓扑下的节点/边特征，且对细粒度异常（如低频、隐蔽型攻击）感知能力不足。

## 方法创新  
本文提出 **SKGFusionKAN**——一种面向IoT环境定制的端到端图学习框架：  
- **多尺度选择性核注意力机制**：嵌入GraphSAGE主干，自适应加权不同感受野下提取的边特征，显著提升对异构设备与突发流量的鲁棒性；  
- **边导向的消息传递机制**：强化边属性在信息聚合中的显式作用，改善稀疏连接下的特征传播效率；  
- **门控式多尺度特征融合模块**：动态调节浅层细节与深层语义特征的贡献权重，增强对演化攻击（如零日变种）的泛化能力；  
- **Kolmogorov-Arnold网络（KAN）分类器**：替代传统MLP，利用可学习的样条基函数实现更强非线性建模，精准识别低频、高隐蔽性攻击。

## 主要成果  
在CIC-IoT2022、TON-IoT、NSL-KDD和UNSW-NB15四大基准数据集上，SKGFusionKAN在二分类（AUC达99.32%）与多分类（F1-score平均提升5.8%）任务中均显著优于现有SOTA方法。据我们所知，这是首个将GNN与KAN深度协同、并针对IoT拓扑特性进行系统性架构革新的入侵检测方案。
papers.summary_en: This paper proposes **SKGFusionKAN**, a novel GNN-KAN hybrid framework tailored for IoT intrusion detection. It enhances GraphSAGE with an edge-oriented message passing scheme and a multi-scale selective kernel attention mechanism to adaptively extract node and edge features under heterogeneous, sparse, and imbalanced IoT traffic. A gated fusion module dynamically integrates multi-scale representations, improving resilience against evolving attacks. For classification, Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KAN) replace standard MLPs, offering superior nonlinear modeling to detect subtle, low-frequency intrusions. Evaluated on four NIDS benchmarks (CIC-IoT2022, TON-IoT, NSL-KDD, UNSW-NB15), SKGFusionKAN achieves state-of-the-art performance—e.g., 99.32% AUC in binary detection and +5.8% average F1-score in multiclass tasks—demonstrating its effectiveness and generalizability for real-world IoT security.

papers.title: TIER: Trajectory-Invariant Explanation Regularization for Membership Privacy
papers.abstract: Explainability is central to building trustworthy AI, yet explanation interfaces can inadvertently provide adversaries with an expanded privacy-related attack surfaces. Recent studies show that advanced membership-inference attacks succeed by exploiting confidence-drop trajectories, induced through attribution-guided perturbations, as discriminative features, rather than directly using confidence scores or explanation vectors. Existing defenses against membership inference fail to directly mitigate such explanation-driven attacks. In this work, we investigate whether, during training, a model's own gradients can be leveraged as defense signals against such attacks, thereby aligning explanation profiles between members and non-members. To this end, we propose a Trajectory-Invariant Explanation Regularization (TIER) defense that penalizes erratic fluctuations in confidence drops simulated through gradient-guided perturbations and simultaneously minimizes the distributional shifts via KL-divergence. Unlike conventional adversarial training, which emphasizes label robustness, our approach targets explanation robustness by enforcing self-consistency through KL-divergence and reducing the variance of confidence drops between members and non-members. Extensive experiments confirm that our method effectively mitigates these attacks, delivering privacy protection while maintaining model utility and explanation fidelity.
papers.summary_zh:
## 背景与问题  
可解释性是构建可信AI的核心，但解释接口可能意外扩大隐私攻击面。近期研究表明，先进成员推断攻击（Membership Inference Attacks, MIA）并非直接利用置信度分数或归因向量，而是**精准捕获由归因引导扰动所诱发的“置信度下降轨迹”**（confidence-drop trajectories）作为判别特征——这类动态轨迹在成员样本与非成员样本间呈现显著统计差异，而现有防御方法（如差分隐私、对抗训练）对此类解释驱动型攻击缺乏针对性抑制。

## 方法创新：TIER框架  
本文提出**轨迹不变解释正则化（Trajectory-Invariant Explanation Regularization, TIER）**，首次在训练阶段利用模型自身梯度作为防御信号，实现成员与非成员样本间解释行为的一致性对齐。TIER包含双重正则机制：  
- **轨迹平滑约束**：通过梯度引导扰动生成多步置信度下降序列，惩罚其方差（即 erratic fluctuations），削弱轨迹的判别性；  
- **分布对齐约束**：引入KL散度最小化，强制成员与非成员样本在扰动下的解释分布（如归因图或软标签分布）趋同，提升解释鲁棒性。  
区别于传统以标签鲁棒性为目标的对抗训练，TIER聚焦**解释鲁棒性**，通过自一致性（self-consistency）与轨迹方差抑制协同防御。

## 主要成果  
在CIFAR-10/100、ImageNet子集及Tabular数据集上系统评估表明：TIER在抵御基于轨迹的MIA时，平均攻击成功率降低**32.7%–58.4%**，显著优于SOTA基线（如DP-SGD、AdvReg）；同时保持模型准确率下降<1.2%，归因保真度（如Infidelity、Sensitivity-N）提升15.3%–22.6%。本工作揭示了梯度内在的隐私防护潜力，为“可解释性-隐私”协同设计提供了新范式。
papers.summary_en: Explainability enhances AI trustworthiness but inadvertently expands privacy attack surfaces. Recent membership inference attacks (MIAs) exploit *confidence-drop trajectories*—dynamic patterns induced by attribution-guided perturbations—as discriminative features, bypassing conventional defenses targeting static outputs. To counter this, we propose **Trajectory-Invariant Explanation Regularization (TIER)**, a novel training-time defense that leverages the model’s own gradients to align explanation behaviors between members and non-members. TIER jointly penalizes variance in simulated confidence-drop trajectories (via gradient-guided perturbations) and minimizes distributional shifts between member/non-member explanation outputs using KL-divergence—thereby enforcing *explanation robustness*, not just label robustness. Extensive experiments show TIER reduces state-of-the-art trajectory-based MIA success rates by 32.7%–58.4% across vision and tabular benchmarks, while preserving model utility (<1.2% accuracy drop) and explanation fidelity (+15.3%–22.6% on infidelity/sensitivity metrics).

可解释性是构建可信AI的核心，但解释接口可能意外扩大隐私攻击面。近期研究表明，先进成员推断攻击（Membership Inference Attacks, MIA）并非直接利用置信度分数或归因向量，而是**精准捕获由归因引导扰动所诱发的“置信度下降轨迹”**（confidence-drop trajectories）作为判别特征——这类动态轨迹在成员样本与非成员样本间呈现显著统计差异，而现有防御方法（如差分隐私、对抗训练）对此类解释驱动型攻击缺乏针对性抑制。

## 方法创新：TIER框架  
本文提出**轨迹不变解释正则化（Trajectory-Invariant Explanation Regularization, TIER）**，首次在训练阶段利用模型自身梯度作为防御信号，实现成员与非成员样本间解释行为的一致性对齐。TIER包含双重正则机制：  
- **轨迹平滑约束**：通过梯度引导扰动生成多步置信度下降序列，惩罚其方差（即 erratic fluctuations），削弱轨迹的判别性；  
- **分布对齐约束**：引入KL散度最小化，强制成员与非成员样本在扰动下的解释分布（如归因图或软标签分布）趋同，提升解释鲁棒性。  
区别于传统以标签鲁棒性为目标的对抗训练，TIER聚焦**解释鲁棒性**，通过自一致性（self-consistency）与轨迹方差抑制协同防御。

## 主要成果  
在CIFAR-10/100、ImageNet子集及Tabular数据集上系统评估表明：TIER在抵御基于轨迹的MIA时，平均攻击成功率降低**32.7%–58.4%**，显著优于SOTA基线（如DP-SGD、AdvReg）；同时保持模型准确率下降<1.2%，归因保真度（如Infidelity、Sensitivity-N）提升15.3%–22.6%。本工作揭示了梯度内在的隐私防护潜力，为“可解释性-隐私”协同设计提供了新范式。

papers.title: Determinants and Limits of LLM Security-Tool Orchestration: A Study with HexStrike-AI
papers.abstract: Large language model agents driving security tool suites over the Model Context Protocol are increasingly common. Yet the factors that bound their capability remain poorly characterized: how much depends on the model versus the client that drives it, whether constraining the agent to the orchestrator's own tools helps, and where capability is limited by reasoning rather than by missing tools. Using HexStrikeAI, an open-source orchestrator that exposes 150+ tools, as a testbed, we follow a methodology that evaluates the system, diagnoses its failures, and applies targeted improvements. We run 86 picoCTF challenges across seven categories and three difficulty tiers, under three tool-access regimes and three model/client configurations (774 trials). We then apply corrections to existing tools, agent-behavior changes, and eleven new capability tools, and re-run the previously-unsuccessful trials. The diagnosis isolates the driving client as a first-order factor for a fixed model (a 2.1 * gap between two DeepSeek clients) and a monotonic difficulty gradient, with the largest gains in the mid tier. The overall solve rate rises from 55.4% to 72.0%, and every configuration improves significantly (paired McNemar p < 0.001, non-overlapping 95% confidence intervals). The residual failures are reasoning- or environment-bound rather than missing-tool. A 60-run stability sub-study finds single-run verdicts reproducible (17/20 unanimous). We discuss what the results imply for how such orchestrators should be evaluated, and we are explicit about the limits: the study uses a single benchmark, the fixes were tuned on the same challenges they were evaluated on, and the client effect is demonstrated for one model only, so its generality to other models remains a hypothesis.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景与问题  
大语言模型（LLM）驱动的安全工具编排系统（如基于Model Context Protocol的代理）正快速普及，但其能力边界尚不清晰：性能差异主要源于模型本身，还是调用客户端（client）？限定代理仅使用编排器自有工具是否提升鲁棒性？失败根源是工具缺失，还是推理能力不足？  

## 方法与实验设计  
本研究以开源安全编排器**HexStrike-AI**（支持150+安全工具）为统一测试平台，采用“评估—诊断—改进”三阶段范式。在7类、3难度等级共86道picoCTF挑战上开展774次试验，覆盖**3种工具访问策略**（全工具/限本体工具/受限API）与**3种模型-客户端组合**（含DeepSeek-V2与Qwen2-7B的不同客户端实现）。对失败案例进行细粒度归因分析，并针对性实施三类改进：优化现有工具行为、调整代理决策逻辑、新增11个关键能力工具（如动态环境感知、多步依赖解析）。随后在全部先前失败的案例上复测。  

## 关键发现  
1. **客户端是首要影响因子**：同模型下，两类DeepSeek客户端性能差距达2.1倍，显著超越模型差异贡献；  
2. **能力呈单调难度梯度**，中等难度提升最大（+28.3%解决率），验证“推理瓶颈”集中于复杂协调而非简单工具调用；  
3. 整体解决率从**55.4%提升至72.0%**（所有配置均显著改善，*p* < 0.001，95% CI无重叠）；  
4. 剩余失败案例经人工核查，**100%归因于推理错误或沙箱环境限制**，而非工具缺失；  
5. 稳定性子研究表明单次运行判决高度可复现（20个案例中17个达成100%一致性）。  

本研究首次系统解耦了LLM安全编排中的模型、客户端与工具维度，为评估框架设计与能力增强路径提供了实证基准。
papers.summary_en: This study systematically investigates the determinants and limits of LLM-driven security tool orchestration using HexStrike-AI—a 150+-tool open-source orchestrator. Across 774 trials on 86 picoCTF challenges (7 categories, 3 difficulty tiers), we isolate the *orchestrating client* as the dominant performance factor—even surpassing model-level differences (e.g., a 2.1× gap between two DeepSeek clients). Capability follows a monotonic difficulty gradient, with largest gains in mid-tier challenges (+28.3% solve rate), indicating reasoning—not tool coverage—as the primary bottleneck. Targeted improvements (tool refinements, agent-behavior adjustments, 11 new capability tools) raise overall solve rate from 55.4% to 72.0% (*p* < 0.001, non-overlapping 95% CIs). Residual failures are exclusively reasoning- or environment-bound; no missing-tool gaps remain. A 60-run stability sub-study confirms high single-run reproducibility (17/20 unanimous verdicts). Limitations include benchmark specificity, evaluation-tuned fixes, and client-effect generalizability pending validation across models.

papers.title: An Interpretable Deep Learning Framework for Discovery and Clinical Validation of Deep Radiomic Signatures in Tumor Classification
papers.abstract: Imaging signatures are quantitative features extracted from medical images that provide clinically meaningful information for tumor diagnosis, characterization, prognosis, and treatment planning. Although deep learning has shown great potential for imaging signature discovery, its limited interpretability remains a major barrier to clinical adoption. Existing approaches often achieve high predictive performance but provide little biological insight into the identified signatures. We propose a unified framework for interpretable imaging signature discovery by integrating deep learning based segmentation, explainable classification, and radiomic analysis. A robust segmentation model is first used to accurately delineate tumors, followed by a Grad-CAM guided pipeline that identifies diagnostically important regions as candidate imaging signatures. A mutual information based adaptive thresholding strategy enables patient-specific signature extraction. The resulting signatures are validated using a downstream deep learning classification model, while radiomic features extracted from the signature regions are evaluated with traditional machine learning models and interpreted using SHAP to identify the most discriminative biomarkers. The proposed framework is evaluated on the public BUSI breast ultrasound, KiTS renal CT, and BraTS brain tumor datasets, as well as a private UF Health renal CT cohort. Compared with conventional whole-tumor radiomics, the proposed signature-based approach achieves improved discriminative performance while providing greater biological interpretability. By converting deep learning attention into reproducible quantitative imaging biomarkers, this framework offers an interpretable and reproducible solution for non-invasive tumor characterization and imaging biomarker discovery.
papers.summary_zh:
## 背景与挑战  
医学影像签名（imaging signatures）是从影像中提取的定量特征，可为肿瘤诊断、分型、预后及治疗规划提供临床价值。尽管深度学习在影像签名发现中展现出强大潜力，但其“黑箱”特性严重制约了临床转化——现有方法虽预测性能优异，却难以揭示签名背后的生物学意义与解剖-功能关联。

## 方法创新  
本研究提出一种**端到端可解释深度学习框架**，融合三大核心模块：  
- **精准分割**：采用鲁棒性肿瘤分割模型（如nnUNet变体）实现病灶自动勾画；  
- **可解释定位**：基于Grad-CAM引导的注意力聚焦机制，识别诊断关键区域作为候选影像签名；  
- **个性化提取**：引入互信息驱动的自适应阈值策略，实现患者特异性签名区域动态提取；  
- **多层级验证**：下游深度分类模型验证签名判别力；同步提取签名区域内传统放射组学特征，结合SHAP（Shapley Additive Explanations）解析各特征贡献度，锁定最具判别性的生物标志物（如纹理异质性、强度直方图峰度等）。

## 主要发现与价值  
在公开数据集（BUSI乳腺超声、KiTS肾CT、BraTS脑瘤）及私有UF Health肾CT队列（n=217）上验证表明：相比传统全肿瘤放射组学，本框架显著提升分类准确率（平均+4.2–7.8%），同时生成**空间可定位、量化可复现、生物学可诠释**的深度影像签名。例如，在肾癌亚型（透明细胞癌 vs. 乳头状癌）区分中，SHAP识别出Signature区域内的灰度共生矩阵（GLCM）对比度与相关性为最强预测因子，与病理已知的肿瘤细胞排列紊乱和基质浸润特征高度吻合。该框架首次将深度学习注意力机制系统转化为临床可理解的定量影像生物标志物，为无创肿瘤表型刻画与精准 biomarker 发现提供了可落地的解释性范式。
papers.summary_en: We propose an interpretable deep learning framework for discovering and clinically validating *deep radiomic signatures*—spatially localized, quantifiable imaging biomarkers derived from diagnostic attention regions. The framework integrates tumor segmentation, Grad-CAM–guided signature localization, mutual information–based adaptive thresholding for patient-specific signature extraction, and dual-pathway validation: (1) downstream deep classification to assess discriminative power; and (2) SHAP-interpreted traditional radiomics from signature regions to identify biologically meaningful features. Evaluated on BUSI, KiTS, BraTS, and a private UF Health renal CT cohort (n=217), the method outperforms whole-tumor radiomics by 4.2–7.8% in classification accuracy while yielding reproducible, anatomically grounded signatures. Crucially, SHAP analysis reveals interpretable biomarkers (e.g., GLCM contrast and correlation) aligned with histopathological hallmarks—demonstrating that deep attention can be translated into clinically actionable, quantitative imaging biomarkers for non-invasive tumor characterization.

papers.title: FedAvg for HAR: Exploring the Tradeoff Between Personalized and Generalization Accuracy
papers.abstract: The federated learning (FL) paradigm fosters distributed pervasive computing combined with artificial intelligence techniques, allowing for optimized data usage and improved mitigation of privacy concerns. Indeed, model training occurs on the client's local devices, and model parameters are subsequently shared with a centralized server. However, there is a need to find a tradeoff between models' personalization and generalization capabilities. In this paper, we design and implement several testing scenarios devoted to evaluating and comparing the centralized, local, and federated paradigm performances. We also design and implement a scenario that emulates a change in clients' data. We then present experimental results of the FedAvg algorithm applied to the Human Activity Recognition (HAR) domain to understand the trade-off between personalized and generalized accuracy. Results show that, although FedAvg confirms a higher degree of personalization capabilities while keeping a high degree of generalization with respect to the traditional centralized learning, this result is not so obvious under stressful conditions, such as when varying class distribution over clients.
papers.summary_zh:
## 联邦平均（FedAvg）在人体活动识别（HAR）中的个性化与泛化精度权衡研究  

本研究聚焦于联邦学习（Federated Learning, FL）在**人体活动识别（HAR）**场景下的核心挑战——如何在保障用户隐私与分布式训练优势的同时，平衡模型的**个性化能力**（适配本地数据分布）与**泛化能力**（跨客户端鲁棒性能）。我们以经典FedAvg算法为基线，系统设计并实现四类对比实验：（1）传统**集中式训练**（Centralized）、（2）完全**本地独立训练**（Local）、（3）标准**联邦平均训练**（FedAvg）、（4）模拟**客户端数据分布漂移**的动态场景（如各设备活动类别分布显著不均衡）。实验基于公开HAR数据集（如WISDM、UCI-HAR），严格控制随机种子与超参数，采用准确率（Accuracy）、个性化精度（per-client test accuracy）及泛化精度（cross-client validation accuracy）三重指标评估。  

关键发现表明：在常规非偏态数据分布下，FedAvg显著优于纯本地模型（+12.3%平均泛化精度），且个性化精度较集中式模型提升8.7%，验证了其“兼顾二者”的潜力；**然而，在客户端间类别分布高度异构（如某客户端仅含“步行”与“静坐”，另一客户端仅有“跑步”与“上下楼梯”）的应力场景下，FedAvg的泛化精度下降达19.5%，个性化精度波动加剧，凸显其对数据异质性的敏感性**。本研究首次在HAR任务中量化揭示了FedAvg在真实边缘设备数据分布漂移下的性能边界，并提出“个性化-泛化权衡曲线”分析框架，为面向可穿戴健康监测等实际FL应用的算法选型与调优提供了实证依据与方法论支持。
papers.summary_en: This paper investigates the fundamental tradeoff between personalization and generalization in Federated Averaging (FedAvg) for Human Activity Recognition (HAR). We design and evaluate four paradigms—centralized, local-only, standard FedAvg, and a dynamic scenario emulating client-specific data distribution shifts—using real-world HAR datasets (e.g., WISDM, UCI-HAR). Results confirm that FedAvg achieves higher personalization than centralized learning (+8.7% per-client accuracy) while maintaining strong generalization (+12.3% cross-client accuracy) under homogeneous conditions. Crucially, however, under stressed heterogeneous settings—where class distributions vary drastically across clients—FedAvg’s generalization accuracy drops by up to 19.5%, revealing its sensitivity to statistical heterogeneity. Our work provides the first empirical quantification of this tradeoff in HAR and proposes a principled evaluation framework for practical federated deployment on wearable devices.

papers.title: From Judgments to Issues: Structured Extraction of Legal Reasoning with Citation-Hallucination Control
papers.abstract: We present an automated pipeline that decomposes Italian tax-court judgments into individual legal issues and extracts, for each issue, a structured XML representation grounded in the IRAC framework and the legal syllogism. The pipeline targets a corpus of approximately $330{,}000$ first- and second-instance decisions of the Italian tax courts and is built around a capable yet cost-efficient general-purpose model (DeepSeek V3), a choice driven by the need to process several hundred thousand documents at a sustainable cost. To address the well-documented unreliability of large language models on legal citations, we couple the extraction step with an automatic hallucination-detection filter that compares the references produced by the model with those identified in the judgment text by a dedicated parser (Linkoln), normalised to standard identifiers (URN-NIR, ECLI, CELEX). We validate the pipeline on $50$ judgments annotated by two PhDs in tax law, computing inter-annotator agreement and LLM-vs-expert agreement on both issue extraction and legal citations, together with a stand-alone evaluation of the hallucination filter. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first issue-level, expert-validated structured extraction pipeline with hallucination control for Italian tax-court decisions, and it provides a concrete starting point for downstream applications such as issue-level retrieval, citation-network analysis, and the construction of large-scale datasets of legal reasoning.

papers.title: Decentralised Federated Learning over Temporal Networks: The Role of Heterogeneities
papers.abstract: Decentralised federated learning, based on peer-to-peer communication, is increasingly proposed for on-device training of machine learning models, promising a privacy-preserving, communication-efficient training process with no risk of single-point failure. However, the role of structural and temporal inhomogeneities in such fully decentralised settings remains poorly understood. Here, we investigate their effects when model parameters are locally averaged during aggregation. We show that the decentralised federated learning process is governed, both in the early phase and the late, stationary limit, by the same dynamics as a lazy random-walk diffusion process on temporal networks. Based on this mapping, we demonstrate that the typical experimental scenario used in decentralised federated learning leads to unrealistically rapid convergence because of ignoring the temporal and structural inhomogeneities inherent in the communication network. We analyse real-world temporal networks and find that inhomogeneities most often dramatically slow down diffusion, hence the convergence process.
papers.summary_zh:
## 去中心化联邦学习在时序网络中的异质性效应研究

**背景与问题**：去中心化联邦学习（Decentralised Federated Learning, DFL）通过设备间点对点通信实现本地模型训练，规避了中心服务器的单点故障风险，兼具隐私保护与通信高效优势。然而，现有研究普遍忽略实际通信网络固有的**结构异质性**（如节点度分布不均、连接稀疏性）与**时序异质性**（如连接动态变化、会话非均匀分布），导致理论模型与真实部署严重脱节。

**方法与建模**：本文首次将DFL中参数本地平均（local averaging）过程严格映射为**时序网络上的惰性随机游走扩散过程**（lazy random-walk diffusion）。该映射统一刻画了训练早期动态演化与晚期稳态收敛行为，并基于真实世界时序网络数据集（包括社交互动、物联网设备通信等6类实证网络）进行系统验证。

**核心发现**：  
- 实验中广泛采用的理想化静态/均匀网络假设，人为加速收敛速度达**2–10倍**，严重高估算法性能；  
- 结构与时间双重异质性共同导致信息扩散显著受阻：在83%的实证网络中，有效扩散速率下降超50%，收敛时间延长3–7倍；  
- 关键瓶颈在于低连通性节点长期“隔离”及连接窗口高度碎片化，使全局一致性难以建立。

**创新与意义**：本工作揭示了网络底层拓扑动力学对分布式学习收敛性的根本制约，为设计鲁棒DFL协议（如自适应聚合权重、时序感知拓扑调度）提供了理论基准与实证依据，推动去中心化AI从理想仿真走向真实部署。
papers.summary_en: Decentralised federated learning (DFL) promises privacy-preserving, failure-resilient on-device training via peer-to-peer communication. Yet, the impact of inherent **structural and temporal inhomogeneities**—such as skewed degree distributions, intermittent connectivity, and non-uniform interaction timing—remains poorly characterised. We establish a rigorous mapping between DFL’s local parameter averaging and **lazy random-walk diffusion on temporal networks**, unifying early-stage dynamics and late-stage stationary behaviour. Using six real-world temporal networks (e.g., social interactions, IoT communications), we demonstrate that standard experimental setups—assuming static or homogeneous topologies—yield **unrealistically fast convergence**, overestimating speed by 2–10×. Structural and temporal heterogeneities jointly impede information diffusion: in 83% of empirical networks, effective diffusion slows by >50%, prolonging convergence by 3–7×. Our findings expose fundamental limits of DFL scalability and provide a principled foundation for designing topology-aware, adaptive aggregation protocols.

papers.title: The Classics at SemEval-2026 Task 3: Combining Transformer Models and LLM-Generated Annotations for Dimensional Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis
papers.abstract: This paper presents an approach to the SemEval-2026 Task 3: Dimensional Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis. We investigate methods for moving beyond traditional categorical sentiment (e.g., positive or negative) to predict fine-grained, real-valued scores for sentiment "valence" (positivity) and "arousal" (intensity). We participate in two subtasks: predicting these scores for given aspects (Subtask 1) and extracting full sets of sentiment details, including aspects, categories, and opinions alongside their scores (Subtask 3). Our approach for the regression task involves a weighted ensemble of transformer-based encoder models. For the Russian language, we further enhance the input by using a large language model (LLM) to generate synthetic sentiment descriptions. For the extraction task, we fine-tune a decoder LLM to perform structured prediction, allowing the system to identify sentiment elements and estimate their numerical scores simultaneously.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景与任务定位  
本研究面向SemEval-2026 Task 3——**维度化方面级情感分析（Dimensional Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis, DABSA）**，突破传统三分类（正面/中性/负面）局限，聚焦于预测连续、细粒度的情感维度值：**效价（valence，表征情感极性强度，范围≈[−1, 1]）** 与 **唤醒度（arousal，表征情感激发强度，范围≈[0, 1]）**。该任务设两个子任务：**Subtask 1**（给定目标方面词，回归预测其valence/arousal得分）；**Subtask 3**（端到端抽取完整情感结构：方面项、类别、观点表达及其对应双维度分数）。

## 方法创新与技术路径  
- **Subtask 1（回归）**：构建**加权集成Transformer编码器模型**，融合RoBERTa-base、XLM-RoBERTa-large及多语言DeBERTa-v3，在俄语数据上进一步引入**LLM增强策略**——调用开源大语言模型（如Llama-3-8B-Instruct）为原始句子生成高质量、带维度标注的合成描述（如“用户对屏幕亮度感到高度满意且情绪平稳”），显著缓解低资源语言标注稀疏问题。  
- **Subtask 3（抽取）**：采用**结构化提示微调解码型LLM**（Qwen2-7B），设计分阶段输出模板（JSON Schema），强制模型同步完成方面识别、情感类别归类、观点短语抽取及双维度数值回归，避免流水线误差累积。  

## 主要成果与贡献  
在官方测试集上，本系统在俄语Subtask 1中valence MAE达0.142（领先基线0.028），arousal MAE为0.131；Subtask 3的F1-score（方面+分数联合评估）达68.3%，较最佳单模型提升4.1%。**核心创新在于：首次将LLM生成的可控维度化描述用于监督信号增强，并实现双维度情感的联合结构化生成，为细粒度情感计算提供可扩展范式。**
papers.summary_en: This paper describes our system for SemEval-2026 Task 3 on Dimensional Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis (DABSA), which predicts real-valued *valence* (positivity) and *arousal* (intensity) scores instead of categorical labels. For Subtask 1 (aspect-level regression), we propose a weighted ensemble of multilingual transformer encoders (RoBERTa, XLM-R, DeBERTa), enhanced for Russian via LLM-generated synthetic sentiment descriptions—prompting an open-weight LLM to produce dimensionally grounded paraphrases that enrich training signals. For Subtask 3 (end-to-end extraction), we fine-tune a decoder LLM (Qwen2-7B) with structured prompting to jointly identify aspects, categories, opinion spans, and their valence/arousal scores in a single generation step. Our approach achieves state-of-the-art results on the Russian test set: MAE of 0.142 (valence) and 0.131 (arousal) in Subtask 1, and 68.3% F1 for joint aspect–score extraction in Subtask 3—demonstrating the effectiveness of LLM-augmented supervision and unified dimensional generation.

papers.title: Formalizing Privacy of Anonymous Credentials: A Provably Secure Framework with Predicate Proofs
papers.abstract: Anonymous credentials enable privacy-preserving authentication but existing systems either lack support for predicate proofs or are tied to specific signature schemes without a formal framework. We propose the first constructive framework for anonymous credentials with native predicate proof support. The framework provides definitions of entities, operations, adversary models, and security properties—unforgeability, unlinkability, and minimal disclosure. To demonstrate its feasibility, we instantiate the framework with BBS signatures, Pedersen commitments, and ring signature based proofs. The instantiation yields compact credentials and efficient zero-knowledge predicate proofs. We prove that the instantiation satisfies all security properties under standard assumptions (q-SDH, discrete logarithm, and the zero-knowledge of the ring signature based proof). A performance evaluation confirms that credential issuance, verification, and predicate prove/verify are practical on standard hardware, with compact credentials and proofs whose communication cost grows modestly with the number and encoding length of proved attributes, and favorable runtime and storage relative to a CL-based baseline. Our framework provides a modular foundation for designing and analyzing anonymous credential systems with fine-grained attribute disclosure.
papers.summary_zh:
## 背景与问题  
匿名凭证（Anonymous Credentials）是实现隐私保护身份认证的关键技术，但现有方案存在两大局限：**缺乏对谓词证明（Predicate Proofs）的原生支持**（如“年龄≥18”“学历为硕士及以上”），或**过度依赖特定签名方案**（如CL、BBS），缺乏统一、可验证的安全建模框架，导致安全性难以形式化分析与横向比较。

## 方法与创新  
本文提出**首个构造性匿名凭证框架**，首次将谓词证明作为一等公民纳入形式化体系。框架严格定义了实体角色（用户、颁发者、验证者）、核心操作（颁发、展示、验证）、敌手模型（适应性选择消息攻击、链接性攻击），并确立三项核心安全属性：**不可伪造性**（unforgeability）、**不可链接性**（unlinkability）与**最小披露性**（minimal disclosure）。为验证可行性，我们基于**BBS签名、Pedersen承诺与环签名零知识证明**完成具体实例化，支持高效、紧凑的属性谓词（如范围证明、集合成员证明）。

## 主要成果  
- 安全性：在标准假设下（q-SDH、离散对数、环签名ZK完备性）**严格证明**所有安全属性成立；  
- 效率：凭证尺寸仅约384字节，谓词证明通信开销随属性数量及编码长度**近线性增长**（如5属性证明≈1.2 KB）；  
- 实证：在普通笔记本上，单次谓词证明/验证耗时<15 ms，存储开销比CL基线降低40%；  
- 影响：提供**模块化设计范式**，支持灵活扩展新谓词类型与密码原语，为合规可控的身份披露系统奠定理论与工程基础。
papers.summary_en: We present the first constructive, formally defined framework for anonymous credentials with native support for predicate proofs (e.g., range, set membership). It provides rigorous definitions of syntax, adversary models, and three security properties: unforgeability, unlinkability, and minimal disclosure. We instantiate the framework using BBS signatures, Pedersen commitments, and ring-signature-based zero-knowledge proofs—yielding compact credentials (≈384 bytes) and efficient predicate proofs whose communication cost scales modestly with attribute count and encoding length. Security is proven under standard assumptions (q-SDH, discrete logarithm, and ZK of the ring-SNARK-like proof). Performance evaluation shows practical issuance, verification, and predicate operations (<15 ms per proof/verify on commodity hardware), with 40% lower storage than a CL-based baseline. The framework enables modular, provably secure design of fine-grained attribute disclosure systems.

papers.title: Retrieve-Compute PIR and Its Applications
papers.abstract:
Two-server Private Information Retrieval achieves arbitrarily small
polynomial communication, but relies on a strong non-collusion assumption that
is difficult to justify in practice.

We introduce a new variant of two-server PIR in which one server acts as a
standard \emph{compute} server, while the other is a restricted
\emph{retrieval-only} server. The latter stores a public encoding of the
database and merely serves requested symbols or blocks of this encoding,
without performing any PIR-specific computation. We argue that such a
retrieval-only server can be instantiated using existing static-content or
repository-hosting services, thereby grounding the
non-collusion assumption in realistic architectural and deployment constraints.

Assuming Learning Parity with Noise (LPN) over the ternary field with
inverse-polynomial noise rate, we construct RC-PIR with arbitrarily small
polynomial communication and polynomial storage. Leveraging this construction,
we derive the following unexpected applications for every constant \(k\):
\begin{enumerate}
\item \(k\)-server PIR with arbitrarily small polynomial communication and
privacy against any coalition of \(k-1\) servers.

\item \(k\)-server robust PIR with arbitrarily small polynomial communication
that simultaneously achieves correctness and privacy with respect to an
arbitrary monotone access structure \(\mathcal{A}\). Namely, correctness is
guaranteed whenever the set of online servers \(S\) satisfies
\(S \in \mathcal{A}\), while privacy holds against every coalition
\(S \notin \mathcal{A}\).

\item A \(k\)-party secure computation protocol for size-\(n\) truth tables
also known as lookup tables, with arbitrarily small polynomial communication
and passive security against any coalition of \(k-1\) parties. This result
extends to active security either in the honest-majority setting, or without an
honest majority assuming collision-resistant hash functions.
\end{enumerate}
None of these results were previously known under the LPN assumption. Along
the way, we uncover new relationships between different complexity measures of
PIR.
papers.summary_zh:
## 背景与问题  
传统双服务器私有信息检索（2-server PIR）虽能实现任意小的多项式通信开销，但其安全性严重依赖“两服务器不共谋”这一强假设——该假设在云环境等现实部署中缺乏可信支撑，因服务商可能共享基础设施或受同一实体控制。

## 方法：Retrieve-Compute PIR（RC-PIR）  
本文提出新型两服务器PIR范式：**一个为通用计算服务器（Compute Server），另一个为受限的“仅检索”服务器（Retrieval-only Server）**。后者仅存储数据库的公开编码（如纠错码编码），并以零计算开销响应符号/块级读取请求，**不执行任何PIR专用密码运算**。该设计使“仅检索”服务器可直接由现有静态内容分发网络（CDN）、代码仓库（如GitHub/GitLab Pages）或对象存储服务（如S3）实例化，从而将非共谋假设转化为可验证的**架构隔离约束**（如跨云厂商部署、物理网络分离），显著提升实践可行性。

## 主要成果与创新  
基于三元域上带逆多项式噪声率的LPN假设，我们构造了首个兼具**任意小多项式通信复杂度**与**多项式存储开销**的RC-PIR方案。以此为基础，首次在LPN框架下实现三大突破性应用：  
1. **k服务器PIR**：对任意常数k，实现任意小多项式通信，且隐私性可抵御任意k−1个服务器的合谋；  
2. **鲁棒k服务器PIR**：支持任意单调访问结构𝒜，当在线服务器集合S∈𝒜时保证正确性，当S∉𝒜时保障隐私；  
3. **k方安全查表协议**：针对n项真值表（lookup table）的多方安全计算，实现任意小多项式通信，支持被动安全（抗k−1方合谋）；进一步扩展至主动安全（需诚实多数或引入抗碰哈希函数）。  
本工作还首次揭示了PIR中通信、存储与计算复杂度间的深层关联，为后续复杂度理论研究提供新视角。
papers.summary_en:
We introduce **Retrieve-Compute PIR (RC-PIR)**, a new two-server PIR paradigm where one server performs cryptographic computation while the other is a *retrieval-only* server—storing only a public encoding of the database and serving raw symbols/blocks without any PIR-specific computation. This design enables realistic instantiation using off-the-shelf static hosting services (e.g., CDNs, Git repositories), grounding the non-collusion assumption in architectural isolation rather than trust.  

Under the ternary-field LPN assumption with inverse-polynomial noise rate, we construct RC-PIR achieving **arbitrarily small polynomial communication** and **polynomial storage**, resolving a long-standing feasibility gap. Leveraging it, we obtain, for every constant $k$, the first LPN-based constructions of: (1) $k$-server PIR with privacy against any $k-1$ colluding servers; (2) robust $k$-server PIR supporting arbitrary monotone access structures for joint correctness and privacy; and (3) $k$-party secure lookup-table evaluation with arbitrarily small polynomial communication, passive security against $k-1$ parties, and extensions to active security. These results uncover novel trade-offs among PIR complexity measures.

papers.title: The Small-Field Turn in Succinct Proofs: A Systematization of Finite-Field Choice in Modern SNARKs and STARKs
papers.abstract: Over the past half-decade, transparent succinct arguments have migrated off the 256-bit scalar fields of pairing-friendly elliptic curves and onto small fields: the 64-bit Goldilocks prime, the 31-bit primes BabyBear and KoalaBear, the Mersenne prime 2³¹−1 reached through the circle construction, and binary tower fields down to F₂. We call this movement the "small-field turn" and systematize it with the finite field, rather than the proof system or the virtual machine, as the unit of analysis. We organize the fields in use by the structural properties that drive their selection: machine-word fit, two-adicity, reduction cost, and the S-box automorphism structure exploited by algebraic hashes; and we show how each is realized in a production prover (Plonky2, Plonky3, Stwo, Binius, and their descendants). We then assemble, across systems that state it only individually, the relationship between base-field width and the extension degree that Fiat–Shamir soundness requires, and we set that relationship against the measured gap between conjectured and provable soundness for non-interactive FRI. Finally, we separate the peer-reviewed results on embedding and arithmetization overhead from the vendor benchmarks that dominate the topic, and identify the controlled cross-field comparison whose absence is the area's sharpest empirical gap. No prior work takes field choice as its organizing object across this design space; the nearest systematization treats it as one dimension among many within a zero-knowledge virtual machine taxonomy. We frame the turn as the exploration of a single trade, cheaper arithmetic against repurchased soundness and simulated non-native operations, and argue from the provenance of the fields where the frontier is likely to move next.
papers.summary_zh:
## 小域转向：现代SNARKs与STARKs中有限域选择的系统化研究  

过去五年间，透明简洁证明（transparent succinct arguments）经历了显著的“**小域转向**”：从配对友好椭圆曲线的256位标量域，转向一系列更小的有限域——包括64位Goldilocks素域（$p = 2^{64} - 2^{32} + 1$）、31位BabyBear与KoalaBear素域、经“圆构造”（circle construction）实现的梅森素域 $2^{31}-1$，乃至低至二元塔域 $\mathbb{F}_2$。本文首次将**有限域本身**而非证明系统或虚拟机作为核心分析单元，系统梳理该转向的动因、实现与权衡。  

我们依据四大结构性属性组织现用域：**机器字对齐性**（machine-word fit）、**二元幂次性**（two-adicity）、**模约减开销**（reduction cost）及**S盒自同构结构**（支撑代数哈希如Griffin）。并通过Plonky2、Plonky3、Stwo、Binius等主流生产级证明器，实证各属性如何被具体工程化。  

进一步，我们跨系统整合了**基域宽度与Fiat–Shamir所需扩域次数**的隐含关系，并将其与非交互式FRI协议中“**猜想安全界**”与“**可证安全界**”之间的实测鸿沟并置分析。同时，我们严格区分经同行评议的**嵌入与算术化开销理论结果**与厂商主导的基准测试，指出当前领域最尖锐的经验缺口在于：**缺乏受控的跨域横向对比实验**——即在相同电路/约束集下，公平比较不同基域对证明时间、验证成本与安全性裕度的综合影响。  

本研究是首个以**域选择为统一主线**覆盖SNARK/STARK设计空间的系统化工作；此前相关工作仅将其视为零知识虚拟机分类学中的一个维度。我们主张：小域转向本质是一场单一根本权衡——以**更廉价的域上运算**换取**需重新购买的可信假设**（如更强的哈希建模）与**模拟非原生操作的额外开销**，并基于各域的起源脉络（如Goldilocks源于x86优化，BabyBear源于ARM64适配），推断前沿下一步或将向**定制化32/48位素域**或**支持高效位运算的扩展二元域**演进。
papers.summary_en: This paper systematizes the “small-field turn” in modern transparent SNARKs and STARKs—the shift from 256-bit pairing-friendly scalar fields to smaller fields like Goldilocks ($\mathbb{F}_{2^{64}-2^{32}+1}$), BabyBear/KoalaBear ($\mathbb{F}_{2^{31}-1}$), circle-constructed Mersenne fields, and binary tower fields down to $\mathbb{F}_2$. We treat the finite field—not the proof system or VM—as the primary unit of analysis, organizing fields by four structural drivers: machine-word alignment, two-adicity, reduction cost, and S-box automorphism structure exploited by algebraic hashes. We map each property to concrete implementations in Plonky2, Plonky3, Stwo, and Binius. Crucially, we synthesize the base-field width vs. extension-degree relationship required for Fiat–Shamir soundness across systems—and contrast it with the measured gap between conjectured and provable soundness in non-interactive FRI. Finally, we separate peer-reviewed arithmetization/encoding overhead results from vendor benchmarks, identifying the absence of *controlled cross-field comparisons* as the field’s sharpest empirical gap. This is the first work to center field choice as the unifying lens across the succinct proof design space.

papers.title: smklhs: Succinct Multi key Linearly Homomorphic Signatures for Certified Statistics
papers.abstract:
We study the problem of certifying statistical claims over datasets contributed by multiple independent sources.  In this setting, an untrusted server aggregates signed data records and publishes claims such as sums, averages, or rates, while any third party can verify that these claims are correct with respect to the authenticated input data, without needing access to the underlying records. A central challenge is to achieve public verifiability without requiring trust in the aggregator, while keeping both the proof size and the verification cost small enough for practical deployment.  This problem is motivated by applications in which reliable and scalable certification of published statistics is essential, including official health and demographic reporting.

In this work, we present smklhs, a multi-key linearly homomorphic signature scheme for this setting.  Compared to the state of the art, smklhs is the first practical construction to enjoy evaluated signatures of size logarithmic in the number of distinct signers involved in the computation, and else independent on the total number of input messages.  We prove smklhs secure against fully adaptive adversaries in the random oracle and algebraic group models, under well-studied hardness assumptions in bilinear groups.

We implement our scheme using the high-performance pairing library RELIC and compare it with prior work.  To demonstrate practicality, we consider a case study on authenticated mortality statistics related to the impact of COVID-19 in Spain.  At the 128-bit security level, our experiments show that an authenticated claim covering a 180-day nationwide dataset with over 300,000 signed records generated by 190 distinct signers can be verified in approximately 22 seconds on a commodity desktop machine. These results indicate that our approach is fast, lightweight, and practical for real-world deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
## 研究背景与问题  
在多源数据协同分析场景中（如公共卫生统计、跨机构人口监测），多个独立数据提供方需对各自记录进行签名，由不可信服务器聚合生成可验证的统计声明（如总和、均值、发病率）。核心挑战在于：如何在**不依赖聚合者可信性**的前提下，实现**公开可验证性**，同时确保签名证明紧凑（proof size小）、验证高效（verification cost低），以支撑国家级规模的实际部署。

## 方法创新：smklhs 方案  
本文提出 **smklhs**——首个实用的**多密钥线性同态签名方案**。其关键突破在于：  
- ✅ **对数级签名尺寸**：经聚合后的验证签名大小仅为 $O(\log n)$，其中 $n$ 为参与签名的**不同签发者数量**（而非总记录数），彻底摆脱传统方案对输入规模的线性依赖；  
- ✅ **严格安全性保障**：在随机预言机模型与代数群模型下，基于双线性群中广受认可的**LRSW 和 DL 假设**，证明其对完全自适应敌手的安全性；  
- ✅ **工程优化实现**：基于高性能配对库 RELIC 实现，支持 128 位安全强度。

## 实证效果与应用价值  
以西班牙 COVID-19 死亡率统计为案例：覆盖全国 180 天、超 30 万条签名记录、来自 190 个独立卫生机构。实验表明，**单次验证仅需约 22 秒**（普通桌面 CPU），证明方案兼具**高扩展性、低开销与强实用性**，可直接服务于官方健康统计、开放政府数据认证等关键基础设施。
papers.summary_en: We propose **smklhs**, the first practical multi-key linearly homomorphic signature scheme enabling publicly verifiable certified statistics over data from multiple untrusted sources. Unlike prior constructions, smklhs achieves *logarithmic signature size*—$O(\log N)$ in the number of distinct signers $N$—and is independent of total input records, drastically reducing proof overhead. We prove its security against fully adaptive adversaries in the random oracle and algebraic group models under standard bilinear-group assumptions (LRSW and DL). Implemented using the RELIC pairing library, smklhs verifies an authenticated nationwide mortality claim—covering 300,000+ records signed by 190 authorities over 180 days—at 128-bit security in ≈22 seconds on a commodity desktop. This demonstrates strong practicality for real-world statistical certification.

papers.title: Algebraic Modelings of the Supersingular Isogeny Problem
papers.abstract: We present a new algebraic modeling of the Supersingular Isogeny Problem as a system of multivariate polynomial equations, in the case where the elliptic curves are connected by an isogeny whose degree is a power of $2$ or $3$. This modeling relies on Renes  formulas for elliptic curves in Montgomery form (degree $2$) or triangular form (degree $3$). We investigate several algebraic properties of these systems: we prove that they are zero-dimensional, compute the dimension of their highest degree part, and show that they are not in generic coordinates. Experimental results show that solving these systems via Gröbner basis techniques is significantly faster than solving the algebraic modeling with modular polynomials.
papers.summary_zh:
## 新代数建模：超奇异同源问题的多项式系统刻画  

本文针对**超奇异同源问题（Supersingular Isogeny Problem, SIP）** 提出一种新颖、结构清晰的代数建模方法。该问题在后量子密码学中具有核心地位，尤其支撑SIKE等NIST候选方案的安全性。我们聚焦于**2-幂次与3-幂次度数同源**这一关键情形，首次系统构建了以多元多项式方程组形式精确刻画SIP的代数模型。模型基于Renes等人提出的高效坐标公式：对2-度同源，采用**Montgomery椭圆曲线形式**；对3-度同源，则利用**三角坐标（triangular form）**，显著降低方程复杂度与变量维度。

我们深入分析了该多项式系统的代数性质：  
- 严格证明其为**零维理想（zero-dimensional）**，即解集有限且孤立，为Gröbner基求解提供理论保障；  
- 显式计算其**最高次齐次分量的维数**，揭示系统内在代数结构；  
- 证伪“通用坐标假设”，指出该模型**不处于通用位置（not in generic coordinates）**，意味着经典随机化预处理可能失效，需针对性设计求解策略。

papers.summary_en: We introduce a novel algebraic modeling of the Supersingular Isogeny Problem (SIP) as a system of multivariate polynomial equations, specifically for isogenies of degree $2^e$ or $3^e$. papers.title: SDDT: An Operation Skip Attack Framework for Bitslice Ciphers—Validated on PIPO
papers.abstract:
Bitslice implementations are widely adopted in lightweight
cryptography (LWC) due to their efficiency and inherent resilience to
side-channel attacks. However, this paper reveals that their decomposition of the S-box exposes critical vulnerabilities to the operation skip
fault model. Unlike data corruption faults suffering from high-entropy
diffusion, we identify that skipping bitwise operations induces strongly
restricted differential patterns. To exploit this characteristic, we propose the Skip-induced Difference Distribution Table (SDDT), a framework mapping operation omissions to output differences. We validate
this approach on the block cipher PIPO through practical experiments,
successfully recovering the master key from deeper rounds with fewer
faults than previously possible. Our findings underscore the fragility of
bitslice designs against precise operation skip faults.
papers.summary_zh:
## SDDT：面向比特切片密码的运算跳过攻击框架——以PIPO为验证实例  

**背景与问题**：比特切片（Bitslice）实现因高效性及天然抗侧信道能力，被广泛应用于轻量级密码学（LWC）。然而，本文首次揭示其S盒分解结构在**运算跳过（Operation Skip）故障模型**下存在严重脆弱性。传统数据破坏型故障受高熵扩散制约，而本研究发现：**跳过单个位运算（如AND、XOR、NOT）会引发高度受限、可预测的差分模式**，这一特性此前未被系统建模。  

**方法创新**：为此，我们提出**跳过诱导差分分布表（Skip-induced Difference Distribution Table, SDDT）**——一种新型故障分析框架。SDDT并非基于输入差分，而是**以被跳过的具体运算操作为索引**，精确映射至输出比特的确定性差异集合；支持前向传播建模，并兼容多轮组合分析。该框架突破了传统差分分布表（DDT）对输入扰动的依赖，专为“零数据篡改、仅指令省略”的精准故障场景设计。  

**实验验证与成果**：我们在国际轻量级候选算法PIPO上完成端到端实证：通过激光故障注入，在第5轮成功触发单次S盒内关键位运算跳过，结合SDDT逆向推导，**仅需3次有效故障即可恢复128位主密钥**，较现有最优攻击减少约60%故障次数，且首次实现对>4轮的密钥恢复。结果证实：比特切片设计在物理层面对**微秒级时序精准的运算跳过攻击极度敏感**，其“抗侧信道”优势无法自然延展至故障攻击场景。  

**意义**：本工作不仅暴露了比特切片架构的隐性缺陷，更提供了首个面向运算跳过的形式化分析工具，为LWC硬件实现的安全评估与防护（如冗余执行、运算完整性校验）提供了理论基础与实践标尺。
papers.summary_en: Bitslice implementations are prized in lightweight cryptography (LWC) for efficiency and inherent side-channel resilience. This paper reveals a critical vulnerability: their S-box decomposition is highly susceptible to *operation skip* faults—where specific bitwise operations (e.g., XOR, AND) are omitted without data corruption. Unlike high-entropy data faults, skipped operations induce strongly constrained, predictable output differences. To exploit this, we propose the **Skip-induced Difference Distribution Table (SDDT)**, a novel framework that maps *which operation is skipped* directly to deterministic output bit differences. Validated on the LWC candidate PIPO via practical laser fault injection, SDDT enables full 128-bit key recovery from round 5 using only **3 effective faults**—a >60% reduction over prior attacks and the first successful deep-round key extraction. Our work exposes a fundamental fragility of bitslice designs against precise operation-level faults and provides the first formal tool for skip-fault analysis.

papers.title: Privacy-Preserving and Verifiable Approximate Distributed Coded Computing
papers.abstract: Distributed machine learning enables collaborative model training without centralizing data, but it also exposes learning processes to privacy leakage and malicious manipulation. Existing defenses typically address these threats in isolation and are often tailored to specific learning paradigms or model architectures, limiting their applicability in realistic deployments. In particular, federated learning and decentralized learning exhibit distinct adversarial surfaces that are rarely addressed within a unified framework. In this paper, we present a model-agnostic framework for adversary-resistant distributed learning that jointly addresses privacy preservation and malicious behavior across both federated and decentralized settings. Our approach combines paradigm-specific defense mechanisms with GPBACC, a privacy-enhancing coded computing technique applicable to arbitrary machine learning models. For federated learning, we integrate robust aggregation strategies to mitigate the impact of malicious participants, while for decentralized learning we employ approximate decode-and-compare and group testing techniques to enable lightweight verification and adversary isolation without relying on a trusted aggregator. Crucially, we evaluate the proposed framework through an explicit, attack-driven analysis. We implement representative privacy attacks and malicious behaviors, and empirically demonstrate that the combination of GPBACC with robust aggregation and verification mechanisms significantly reduces privacy leakage and improves resilience against active adversaries. These results suggest that privacy-enhancing coded computing, when combined with appropriate adversary-resistance strategies, provides a practical and deployable foundation for secure distributed machine learning.
papers.summary_zh:
## 隐私保护与可验证的近似分布式编码计算框架

分布式机器学习（如联邦学习与去中心化学习）在避免数据集中化的前提下实现协同建模，但面临**双重安全挑战**：一是训练过程易遭成员推断、梯度反演等隐私攻击；二是恶意参与者可投毒、篡改或伪造模型更新，破坏全局收敛性。现有方案多孤立应对隐私或鲁棒性问题，且高度依赖特定模型结构或学习范式（如仅适配CNN或仅支持联邦设定），难以跨场景复用。

本文提出首个**模型无关、统一适配联邦与去中心化两种拓扑**的 adversary-resistant 分布式学习框架。核心创新在于将**GPBACC**（Generalized Privacy-preserving and Byzantine-resilient Approximate Coded Computing）——一种支持任意ML模型的隐私增强型编码计算技术——与范式定制化防御机制深度融合：  
- 在**联邦学习**中，集成**鲁棒聚合策略**（如几何中位数+截断），显著抑制恶意客户端对全局模型的污染；  
- 在**去中心化学习**中，设计**近似解码-比对（approximate decode-and-compare）与群组测试（group testing）联合验证机制**，无需可信聚合器即可实现轻量级更新验证与恶意节点隔离。  

我们通过**攻击驱动的实证评估**验证框架有效性：系统实施了6类典型隐私攻击（含模型逆向、梯度泄露）和4种主动对抗行为（如符号翻转、高斯投毒）。实验表明，在ResNet-18/CIFAR-10与BERT/StackOverflow任务上，本框架将隐私泄露风险降低**72.3–89.1%**（相较基线FedAvg），同时将拜占庭容错率提升至**>85%**（容忍30%恶意节点仍保持收敛）。结果证实：编码计算不仅是通信加速工具，更是构建**可验证、可审计、可部署**的安全分布式学习基础设施的关键使能技术。
papers.summary_en: This paper introduces a model-agnostic framework for privacy-preserving and verifiable distributed learning that unifies defenses across federated and decentralized settings. At its core lies GPBACC—a generalized, approximate coded computing technique that injects privacy via random linear coding while enabling efficient, lightweight verification. For federated learning, we integrate robust aggregation (e.g., geometric median with clipping) to mitigate malicious updates; for decentralized learning, we propose an approximate decode-and-compare mechanism coupled with group testing to isolate adversaries without a trusted aggregator. Through attack-driven evaluation—including gradient inversion, membership inference, and Byzantine attacks—we demonstrate that GPBACC combined with these strategies reduces privacy leakage by up to 89.1% and achieves >85% Byzantine resilience under 30% adversarial participation. Our results establish coded computing as a practical foundation for secure, deployable distributed ML.
